title: Nvidia Has $21 Billion SpaceX Stake, $30 Billion in Intel Shares
zh_title: 輝達揭露持有太空探索與英特爾股權
summary: Nvidia Corp on Friday disclosed a nearly $21 billion stake in Elon Musk’s SpaceX and a $30 billion one in Intel Corp

title: Anthropic Revenue Ahead of IPO Surges Over 14-Fold in Second Quarter
zh_title: Anthropic 第二季營收成長逾 14 倍

title: French tax breach exposes nearly 678,000 people as crypto wrench attacks pile up
zh_title: 法國稅務資料外洩恐加劇加密貨幣暴力搶劫
summary: Crypto wrench attacks in France are on pace to make 2026 the worst year ever for violent crimes targeting crypto holders in the country
zh_summary: 法國稅務部門發生大規模資料外洩事件，導致近六十八萬名國民的個人資訊暴露於風險之中。這項安全漏洞預計將使針對加密貨幣持有者的暴力攻擊增加，並讓二零二六年成為相關犯罪最嚴重的一年。

title: Cboe seeks SEC nod for first US 3x bitcoin and ether ETFs
zh_title: Cboe申請美國首檔三倍比特幣與乙太幣ETF
summary: LeverageShares debuted the world’s first 3x bitcoin and ether ETFs in Europe. These would be the first in the U.S., if approved
